questions.prompt: Rensenware, a unique 2017 ransomware, forced victims to play a video game instead of paying money to decrypt their files. On which difficulty level did victims have to score at least 0.2 billion points in the Touhou game 'TH Suzunaan' to unlock their files?
questions.hint: The required difficulty is not one of the two easiest settings in the game.
questions.explanation: Rensenware required victims to score at least 0.2 billion points in the Touhou Project game 'TH Suzunaan' on the Lunatic difficulty level within two hours to have their files decrypted.

questions.prompt: Skunk is a malodorant liquid crowd-control weapon developed in Israel and used against protesters. In what year was it first deployed operationally by Israeli forces?
questions.explanation: The Skunk malodorant spray was first used operationally by Israeli security forces in 2008 as a non-lethal method of dispersing protesters and crowds.

questions.prompt: According to the Wikipedia article 'List of non-standard dates', which discusses calendar oddities and irregularities, how many days were skipped in the British Empire in September 1752 when switching from the Julian to the Gregorian calendar?
questions.hint: Look between the ranges of 8 and 14
questions.explanation: When the British Empire adopted the Gregorian calendar in September 1752, the days from September 3 to September 13 were omitted, meaning 11 days were skipped to align the calendar with the solar year.

questions.prompt: Limbo of the Lost, a 2008 PC adventure game, was pulled from shelves after it was discovered that many of its graphical assets were plagiarized from other sources. Which online virtual world was one of the sources for these stolen assets?
questions.hint: It's not a game with combat or point-based virtual currency for young players — it's a free-form 3D social virtual world popular in the mid-2000s.
questions.explanation: Investigations revealed that Limbo of the Lost's developers had lifted 3D models and textures from several sources, including the virtual world Second Life, as well as other commercial video games, leading to the game's withdrawal from sale.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a real unusual article?
questions.hint: The correct answer is a South Korean online encyclopedia that has become one of the most visited websites in South Korea, known for its informal tone and extensive use of internet slang, and is not officially affiliated with the Wikimedia Foundation.
questions.explanation: Namuwiki is a South Korean wiki platform that has grown to become one of the largest and most visited websites in South Korea, known for its casual writing style and extensive coverage of pop culture topics.
